messages:
emily_support: Hey @mike_auditor — we got your SOC 2 evidence request re: the 2026-03-12 customer report (API auth failures that correlated with billing spikes). Will package logs + repro steps.

mike_auditor: Thanks. For scope: 1) API auth/access logs for tenant_id=acct-4123 for 2026-03-12 02:00-04:00 UTC; 2) any trace IDs or spans that show failed token exchanges; 3) KMS/HSM access and rotation records for key 'redwood-prod-enc'; 4) retention/deletion job runs for that tenant. Also need a minimal curl repro we can run internally. Please include provenance (where artifacts were pulled from) and ETA.

raj_engineer: Repro snippet below — this reproduces the token-exchange failure we observed in staging: 

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/token \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{"grant_type":"client_credentials","client_id":"acct-4123","client_secret":"<REDACTED>"}' \\\n  -H 'X-Request-Id: repro-20260312-01'
```

The failure mode was a 401 with body: `\{"error\":\"invalid_grant\"}`. Trace id `trace-0a9c` is in the access logs.

emily_support: note — DO NOT use real client_secret in the repro. We provide a sanitized curl that hits the internal replay endpoint. 

raj_engineer: Log locations: 
- API access logs: `logs-prod:/services/api/access/2026/03/12/access.log.gz` (grep for acct-4123 or trace-0a9c)
- Auth service traces (Jaeger): service=auth, trace=trace-0a9c
- Billing events: `events-prod:/billing/processed/2026-03-12/*.ndjson`

jason_security: For KMS/HSM evidence: we'll export the following artifacts to the compliance bucket: 
- `s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026-03/kms-exports/redwood-prod-enc-access-20260312.json.gz`
- `s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026-03/hsm-admin-ops-20260312.json.gz`
- rotation manifest `s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2025-11/key-rotation-manifest-redwood-prod-enc-20251101.json`

Notes: HSM vendor redacts raw key material and some sensitive fields. We will include a signed attestation describing what was redacted and why (standard for vendor-managed HSMs).

mike_auditor: OK — need confirmation that the KMS export includes caller identity (IAM principal), timestamp, operation (Encrypt/Decrypt/Rotate), and request IDs. Also need the retention policy doc and proof that deletion jobs run on schedule.

raj_engineer: Deletion job evidence: job_id `retention-20260312-77`, logs at `jobs-prod:/retention/2026-03-12/retention-20260312-77.log` with lines like: 
`2026-03-12T02:30:12Z INFO delete tenant=acct-4123 objects=452 older_than=90d job_id=retention-20260312-77`

emily_support: I'll collect the specific log extracts (access + retention + billing) and upload to the secure auditor share. ETA 24-48 hours.

auditor-bot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-2391. Assigned to emily_support; SLA target: 48h.

mike_auditor: Also please include a short repro checklist we can follow internally to verify the billing spike correlation (which metrics to look at and the sample queries).

raj_engineer: Quick queries: 
- Access-count: `SELECT count(*) FROM api_access WHERE tenant='acct-4123' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-12T02:00' AND '2026-03-12T04:00'`
- Failed-token-exchanges: `SELECT * FROM auth_errors WHERE tenant='acct-4123' AND error='invalid_grant'`

jason_security: Timeline & provenance we'll include in the bundle: 
- Artifact manifest (JSON) listing S3 paths + checksums + extraction commands.
- Who pulled: `emily_support` (ops role) and `raj_engineer` (eng role).
- Chain of custody note: extracted at 2026-03-15T10:12:00Z from production read-only exports.

emily_support: Uploading now to the auditor share (will DM link). cc @jason_security for the HSM attestation docs.

mike_auditor: Thanks — once uploaded, I'll validate the artifact set and follow up if we need samples or a narrower window. :eyes:

jason_security: One more note — HSM raw logs are stored for 1 year; KMS API logs retained 2 years in the compliance bucket. Retention policy doc: `https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/retention-policy-v2.pdf`.

emily_support: thanks all. I'll post the share link and EVID-2391 update once upload finishes. :thumbsup:
